# Insight Fitness

> > China's leading fitness equipment innovator and manufacturer, specializing in strength training, cardio equipment, and OEM/ODM services from Qingdao.

Insight Fitness (Qingdao Insight Health Tech Ltd.) is a Shandong Province-based manufacturer offering comprehensive fitness equipment solutions including the Free Power series, RC50 climber, and selectorized machines. The company serves global markets with innovation-driven design and manufacturing capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Fitness Equipment Manufacturing
- OEM/ODM Services
